settings.question: Does it Fit as a Carry-On?
settings.answer: Yes! We've specifically designed the bag to fit as a carry-on on all airlines, including Spirit, United, Frontier, American, Delta, Southwest, Alaska and Hawaiian. Don't see your airline? Email us at support@lumatra.com and we'll confirm within 24 hours.

settings.question: How Do Returns Work?
settings.answer: We stand behind every Lumatra Travel Bag. If anything's not right, our 100-Day Guarantee has you covered — just reach us and we'll make it right. We respond personally within 24 hours.

settings.question: How Much Clothing Can I Pack?
settings.answer: You can comfortably pack up to 10 days' worth of everyday clothing, along with 2 to 3 wrinkle-free dresses, ensuring you're prepared for extended stays or varied occasions.

settings.question: Is It Waterproof?
settings.answer: Yes, it's crafted with a water-resistant PU leather exterior, ensuring your belongings stay dry and protected against rain or accidental spills.

settings.question: What Is The Bag Made Of?
settings.answer: Our Travel Bags are made out of super high-fiber PU leather. This is a form of vegan leather that is both sustainable and climate friendly.

settings.question: Can this Bag Really Save me Money?
settings.answer: The average cost of a checked bag for a round-trip flight ranges between $85–125. That means using the Lumatra travel bag (which classifies as a carry-on) essentially pays for itself on your first trip — and the bag is built to last 15-20 years.
